page_title: ACM 2-1 NAP | AC Milan v Napoli 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Great ball in from Miguel Gutierrez. Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
90+7' David Neres (Napoli) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Mike Maignan sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
90+6' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+4' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+3' David Neres (Napoli) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Stanislav Lobotka is given a rest as he is replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
90+2' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
90+1' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' David Neres (Napoli) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Chiffi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The corner from David Neres (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.
89' David Neres (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Napoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' Luca Marianucci (Napoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
88' Noa Lang (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan easily deals with the threat.
86' David Neres (Napoli) probably handled the ball.
84' This shall not pass! Eljif Elmas (Napoli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
84' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
82' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' David Neres (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
81' David Neres (Napoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mike Maignan is quickest to intercept the ball.
80' The game has come to an end for Youssouf Fofana. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
80' Massimiliano Allegri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) suffers an injury and Koni De Winter comes on.

78' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Chiffi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Politano departs the field of play to be replaced by Noa Lang (Napoli).
75' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
75' David Neres (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
74' Napoli take a short corner kick.
74' A pass into the penalty area from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
73' Substitution. Scott McTominay did his best and is replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
73' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) replacing Rasmus Hojlund.
72' That's the end of the game for Kevin De Bruyne, who is replaced by Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
69' Substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez will be replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
68' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Alexis Saelemaekers and he is replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
66' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mike Maignan is quickest to intercept the ball.
65' Juan Jesus (Napoli) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
60' 2 - 1 Goal! Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Mike Maignan.
60' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
59' The substitution is prepared. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christian Pulisic.
57' He’s off! Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) gets his marching orders from referee Daniele Chiffi after the VAR review.

57' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan), but referee Daniele Chiffi must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
53' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

53' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Napoli!
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.

49' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Napoli will take a corner.
47' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rasmus Hojlund. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Frank Anguissa (Napoli) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.

41' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
39' Luka Modric (AC Milan) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alex Meret with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
38' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
37' Referee Daniele Chiffi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
37' Scott McTominay (Napoli) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
31' 2 - 0 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
29' Mike Maignan leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli).
27' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
26' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement.
25' Dangerous play by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
23' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is cleared by the defence.
21' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
16' Luka Modric (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
15' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
11' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

11' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Mike Maignan. This effort really didn't trouble him.
6' Luka Modric (AC Milan) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Luca Marianucci (Napoli).
3' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Christian Pulisic laid the ball off to Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AC Milan will kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
